svg.title: Harvey Rayhanson — Media Artist, Graphic Designer, and AI Engineer
svg.desc: A system map with the Rayhanson logo at the centre and the projects around it: Enigma MCP, Stanza, JimBro, LeaveBy, GymLog, Virtual Theremin, Gesture Particles, Neon Orbit Arcade. Diamonds mark AI systems, squares product design, circles creative code and sound.
